name: Structured Data File Type
abstract: A container/array data file (HDF5, NeXus) in an ADA bundle whose layout is described by a CDIF DataStructure via cdi:isStructuredBy. The bundle-part analog of the monolithic single-file isStructuredBy pattern (pattern chosen by encoding, not position). Defines properties: @type, ada:componentType, cdi:isStructuredBy. Uses building blocks: cdifDataStructure (cdifProperties).
